subject: Arm-2 nomination scoring pass — 8-model launch outcome and quota-driven serial pacing
context: Owner authorized the nomination scoring pass (2026-08-27). All 8 SCORE packets (base, arm1, kdcontrol, h0..h4) were authored, committed, reviewed APPROVED, and dispatched together as arm2_scoring protected-workflow launches on the base-mode evaluator image sha256:985c4d9e.

root_cause.message: The account-level service limit 'ml.g6.xlarge for training job usage' is 2 Instances, with current utilization of 2 Instances and a request delta of 1 Instances.
root_cause.diagnosis: NOT code, packet, or IAM. base+arm1 consumed the account's only 2 concurrent ml.g6.xlarge training slots; the remaining 6 CreateTrainingJob calls were rejected synchronously (SageMaker does not queue training jobs). The six 2,000-step training runs never tripped this because they were launched serially, one at a time.
root_cause.ruled_out: IAM/role scoping (the create+addtags and versioned-read grants applied for the scoring role are correct and were exercised by the two successful launches); packet render/validate (all 8 returned PASS_EXACT_TRAINING_REQUEST at authoring).

resolution.decision: Serial pacing at the quota ceiling: run at most 2 scoring jobs concurrently. base+arm1 hold the 2 slots now; re-dispatch the 6 failed arms two-at-a-time as slots free (kdcontrol+h0, then h1+h2, then h3+h4). Each re-dispatch is a fresh arm-tier protected-workflow launch requiring owner environment-gate approval. Attestation of completed receipts runs in parallel with the next training pair (attest is a signing workflow, not a g6.xlarge job).
resolution.alternative_not_taken: Request an AWS Service Quotas increase for 'ml.g6.xlarge for training job usage'. Owner action; AWS approval latency (hours-to-day) likely exceeds the ~2h wall-clock of serial pacing given ~40-min decode jobs. Left available to the owner if faster parallelism is wanted.
resolution.no_wasted_spend: The 6 failed launches created no training jobs and incurred no SageMaker billable time (failure was at CreateTrainingJob, before any instance start).

next: On base+arm1 completion: recover+cryptographically verify their receipts, attest (2nd gate each), then dispatch kdcontrol+h0. Repeat until all 8 receipt sets exist and are attested, then run the committed Stage-1 Holm scorer over the 24-test family for the provisional finalist.
